name: ATM Device Report V 05
definition: The ATMDeviceReport message is sent to an acquirer by an ATM, or forwarded by an agent, to report:|- The result of maintenance commands performed by the ATM,|- The components of the ATM,|- The status of the ATM components.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMDeviceReport.name: ATM Device Report
ATMDeviceReport.definition: Information related to the status report from an ATM device.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
